account.title: Sign in to Yuno Energy
account.description: Use the email and password you use in the Yuno app. The integration saves reusable app credentials and renews your session automatically. Your plain password is not retained.

manual.description: Enter values from the setup helper or an existing Yuno app session.

reauth_confirm.description: Use the email and password you use in the Yuno app. The integration saves reusable app credentials and renews your session automatically. Your plain password is not retained.

reauth_manual.description: Enter values from the setup helper or an existing Yuno app session.
